title: Comprar alimentos
communication_goal: Pedir alimentos, cantidades y precios en una tienda.
situation: Haces compras para una comida y conversas con el vendedor.

vocabulary.example: I'd like a kilo of apples.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. I'd like a kilo of apples, please.
dialogue.spanish: Hola. Quisiera un kilo de manzanas, por favor.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes. Can I have two bottles of water?
dialogue.spanish: Sí. ¿Puedo tener dos botellas de agua?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.english: Of course. How many oranges do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Six oranges. How much are the apples?

explanation_es: Para comprar con cortesía usa I'd like + producto y Can I have + producto?. Para precio, How much is...? con singular o How much are...? con plural. Para cantidades contables usa How many...? y para unidades o sustancias, How much...? Añade please y thank you para una interacción natural.
spanish_speaker_notes: I'd like es más cortés que I want en una tienda.
How much are the apples? usa are porque apples es plural.
Can I have...? significa '¿puedo tener/recibir...?' y es una petición, no posesión literal.
Please suele ir al final de la petición: A kilo, please.

targets.text: I'd like a kilo of apples, please.
Can I have two bottles of water?

pronunciation.tip_es: En una tienda, practica la petición completa con una voz amable y una pausa antes de la cantidad.

reading.title: A market order
reading.text: At the market, Rosa buys a kilo of apples, six oranges and two bottles of water. She asks the seller how much the apples are. She pays four dollars and asks for a receipt.

activities.instruction: Relaciona cada frase con su intención.
Escucha: I'd like a kilo of apples, please. Elige lo que compra la persona.
activities.audio_text: I'd like a kilo of apples, please.
activities.feedback: I'd like introduce un pedido cortés.
Apples es plural y usa are.

activities.instruction: Ordena: have / can / two bottles / I / of water / ?
activities.answer: Can I have two bottles of water?
activities.feedback: Can I have formula una petición cortés.

activities.instruction: Corrige: I want a kilo apples, please.
activities.answer: I'd like a kilo of apples, please.
activities.feedback: Usa I'd like y of entre la unidad y el producto.

activities.instruction: Representa una compra: saludo, pedido, precio y agradecimiento.
activities.target: Hello. I'd like ... How much is it? Thank you.

activities.instruction: Lee A Market Order y responde: What does Rosa ask for at the end?
activities.feedback: La última acción es pedir el recibo.

activities.instruction: La IA será un vendedor de mercado. Compra cinco productos con cantidades, pregunta precios y pide un recibo.
activities.scenario: Shopping at a friendly local market.
activities.ai_language: English; include realistic seller follow-up questions

activities.instruction: Graba un diálogo de ocho turnos en una tienda comprando una comida completa.
success_criteria: usa I'd like y Can I have

activities.instruction: Completa: ___ like a kilo, please. How much ___ the oranges? Can I ___ a receipt?

mastery_criteria.retry: Si usas I want en todas las frases, practica cinco pedidos con I'd like y please.
